not_worth_doing.item: Adding a rating to SoftwareApplication to earn the Software app rich result
not_worth_doing.reason: Google needs aggregateRating or review. Add it only if the site shows real, verifiable reviews; never invent one. The site-wide block stays, since it describes the product.

not_worth_doing.item: Expecting FAQ rich results from the FAQPage blocks on the home, integration page and blog post pages
not_worth_doing.reason: Google retired the FAQ rich result for every site from May 7, 2026. The blocks are harmless while the questions stay visible on the page, but they earn no rich result in Google.
